name: employee-training
description: Chapter 3: hire an employee, obtain a licence no role starts with (driving.excavator) and promote an already-held one (blasting) via real click-driven training -- the two proofs the deleted playtests/training.json's beats required -- then complete a blast task. #553: drill_hole is now a queued, vehicle-gated action (a driller physically drives a drill_rig to each hole), so this file also trains driving.drill_rig (no role starts with it either) and buys a drill_rig -- without both, the drill_plan below would queue forever with no vehicle able to claim it. campaign start was replaced with new_game: a manually-bought vehicle spawns at grid centre (FleetPanel/vehicle.ts), and dusty_hollow's 96x40x96 campaign grid put that centre far enough from the drill site to matter; new_game's 64x64x64 default halves the trip. blasting_academy moved from (7,5) (2 tiles from driving_center at (5,5)) to (5,15): enrolInTraining teleports the trainee to one tile outside the school's footprint (EmployeeTraining.ts) on enrolment -- two schools placed that close land the post-training teleport on top of the other school's own footprint, an unreachable navmesh cell that stranded the driller (and the drill_rig with it) permanently once blasting training finished last. drill_plan grid shrunk from 3x3 (9 holes) to 2x2 (4 holes): a single driller/drill_rig lands one hole roughly every 40-45 ticks door-to-door, so 9 holes risked the site's own cash burn (no income anywhere in this file) before the plan finished -- 4 is enough to prove charge/sequence/blast still work post-#553. `event choose 0` follows every tick block: idempotent no-op when nothing is pending (a bare `tick` command refuses outright once one is), and this file's own ~250-tick training-then-drilling runway is long enough for the real event timers to fire at least once (verified: an Aesthetic Pollution lawsuit fires here on seed 42).

steps.description: #553: cash bumped from the default $50,000 to cover the drill_rig ($35,000) on top of the original curriculum's driving_center/blasting_academy/training costs, with headroom for the ~250-tick runway's payroll/vehicle upkeep (no income anywhere in this file) and one lawsuit event (observed: Aesthetic Pollution, $15,000, seed 42).
#553: without a drill_rig on site, drill_hole's vehicle gate (#550) never finds a free vehicle to claim -- the drill_plan below would sit queued forever.

Real UI training gap (parity with the deleted playtests/training.json, #479): driving.excavator belongs to no hiring role (ROLE_STARTING_QUALIFICATION), so a driving_center -- the only school that teaches it -- is the sole in-game path to ever holding it. Placed away from the drill grid below (20,20)-(23,23).

Real click path: open the employee detail panel, confirm the excavator course is genuinely offered and clickable (#479's own concern -- "if this control is missing or disabled with a school standing, the licence belongs to nobody"), then enrol.
TRAINING_BASE_TICKS(20) * TRAINING_LEVEL_COST_MULTIPLIER[1](1) * TRAINING_TIER_SPEED[1](1) -- the exact course length for a Tier-1 driving_center's first level.

expect.note: the excavator licence is genuinely obtained -- no role starts with it, so this is the only way anyone on the roster ever holds it

steps.description: #553: idempotent -- a no-op ('No pending event or invalid option.') when nothing is pending, resolves one when a timer fired mid-tick-block. A bare `tick` refuses outright while an event is pending, so skipping this defensively stalls every tick step after it.

#553: driving.drill_rig belongs to no hiring role either (ROLE_STARTING_QUALIFICATION) -- same parity gap as driving.excavator above, and now load-bearing: without this licence the driller can never staff the drill_rig bought above, so drill_hole's vehicle gate (#550) never claims. No toolbar click here (unlike the excavator step above): the employees panel is already open and employee #1's row already expanded from that step (CrewPanel's `expandedId` is a plain instance field, untouched by the intervening `tick`/`event choose` steps), and ToolRail's tab button is a toggle (UIManager.togglePanel: clicking the tab for the panel that is already active calls hideAllPanels() instead of reopening it) -- re-clicking `[data-panel="employees"]` here closed the panel outright (display:none on #bs-employee-panel), leaving the train button attached to the DOM but zero-sized, which is what `clickSelector "...bs-train-btn[data-skill=\"driving.drill_rig\"]" failed: element has zero size (0x0)` actually meant.
Same course length as the excavator licence above -- both are a Tier-1 driving_center's first level.

expect.note: driving.drill_rig obtained -- the driller can now staff the drill_rig bought above

steps.description: Left unmarked: hiring already grants the Rookie starting qualification (ROLE_STARTING_QUALIFICATION in Employee.ts); this only raises the level for the scenario's needs -- the player-facing path is `employee train`. Free (no cost), unlike a real academy course.

The second half of #479's parity gap: prove a promotion (raising an already-held qualification above Rookie) is obtainable via real clicks too, not just a brand-new licence. #553: moved from (7,5) -- 2 tiles from driving_center at (5,5) -- to (5,15): enrolInTraining's post-enrolment teleport (one tile outside the school's own footprint, EmployeeTraining.ts) landed the driller on driving_center's footprint when the two schools sat this close, an unreachable navmesh cell that permanently stranded them (and the drill_rig reserved for their next drill_hole claim) once blasting training finished last. (5,15) is far enough from both driving_center and the drill grid at (20,20)-(23,23) to avoid it.
Chuck Miner already holds blasting at Rookie (a driller's own ROLE_STARTING_QUALIFICATION) -- this course promotes it, the same control used for a brand-new licence above.
TRAINING_BASE_TICKS(20) * TRAINING_LEVEL_COST_MULTIPLIER[2](1.6) * TRAINING_TIER_SPEED[1](1) = 32 -- the exact course length to promote level 1 to 2.

expect.note: a promotion raises the level of a held qualification rather than adding a second copy of it -- qualificationCount unchanged, proficiencyTotal +1

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:3 depth:6 start:20,20
steps.description: #553: shrunk from the original rows:3 cols:3 (9 holes) to 2x2 (4 holes) -- confirming the grid queues 4 drill_hole PendingActions and pushes 4 PlannedHoles into plannedDrillHoles, none drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm. A single driller/drill_rig lands roughly one hole every 40-45 ticks door-to-door (walk to vehicle, drive, drill, return for the next); 9 holes risked the site's own cash burn (no income anywhere in this file) outrunning the plan.

expect.note: 2 rows x 2 cols = 4 holes ordered (ghosts), none drilled yet (#553)

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan in bounded chunks rather than one huge tick count -- each chunk is followed by `event choose 0` since a `tick` command stops dead the instant a timer event fires mid-block (events.ts), silently short of the requested count.
#553: sandbox-measured landing for this exact sequence (seed 42): all 4 holes down by the end of this 4th 40-tick chunk.

expect.note: All 4 holes have landed — none lost, none left ordered forever.
